description: Distinct constant symbols cannot be unified by any term substitution.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.distinct_constants_no_unifier.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (a b : L.Functions 0)
  (hab : a ≠ b) {α : Type w} (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
      [(Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant a, Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant b)]
